summary: Static and lightweight tests were recorded, SimFoundry Stage 1b completed on its bundled Fruits scan video, and isolated CPU alpha probes completed for BRIA RMBG-2.0 and U2NetP. Full model-backed scene reconstruction, auto-background reconstruction and cross-project scene validation remain unrun.

isolated_preprocessing_environment.purpose: Run the lightweight video preprocessing stage without installing into the active DexAgent environment.
isolated_preprocessing_environment.reproducibility_note: This is a local probe environment, not a complete or locked SimFoundry runtime.

simfoundry_dry_runs.limitation: Dry-runs generated stage commands but did not validate the input file, call models, run OmniGibson, or produce scene/data artifacts.

simfoundry_stage_1b.note: The stage writes PNGs for all source frames, so this small input produced about 326 MiB of local ignored artifacts.

simfoundry_depth_backend_probe.model_selection_code: implemented; model profiles are resolved from s2_da.model_name in both single-pass and chunked paths, and successful stage_info records the profile identity/capabilities/license

known_candidate_blocked_by_output_contra.reason: Downstream Stage 2 consumers treat depth as metric; it is rejected until metric scale calibration is implemented and validated.

simfoundry_u2netp_cpu_probe.license: Apache-2.0 (upstream U-2-Net repository license; not independently assigned to the rembg wrapper)
limitations: No pixel-level ground-truth masks are available.
ROI diagnostics use manually drawn loose object boxes and are not segmentation scores.
This measures per-image alpha only; it does not test temporal consistency or video inpainting.
simfoundry_u2netp_cpu_probe.assessment: CPU inference completed; alpha inspected on apple, banana and pear; no pixel-level masks, so not a scored segmentation benchmark.

simfoundry_bria_cpu_probe.assessment: BRIA and U2NetP visually retain the apple, banana and pear and remove most wood background on this fixed small sample. No pixel-level masks exist; this is not an accuracy comparison. CPU-only timings are not representative of GPU production.

next_gate: Run auto-background incrementally on a fixed scene: first validate the Gemini/SAM3 keyframe mask and SAM2 propagation, then run VOID two-pass inpainting, cleaned-stream DA3 and depth-supervised splat alignment.
